name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A live bar chart for any comparison across categories in json-render chats: free-text topic, web research via Parallel, one bar per category with its value, biggest first, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   BarChartCard: barChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: BarChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveBarChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} limit={props.limit ?? undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     BarChartCard: barChartLookup

Figures load from /api/bar-chart (installed at app/api/bar-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to turn any comparison into one value per category. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). The model sets limit (2–12) for how many bars; null means 8. Topic is free text from the user's question.
